terms.comment: Our noun: Traupman, Morgan–Owens and Levi–Bini have no word for a cheesemonger. The adjective cāseārius, to do with cheese, is in the Digest (taberna cāseāria, Dig. 8.5.8.5, in Lewis & Short); used as a noun for the seller it follows the names of trades in -ārius, such as argentārius, a banker.

sources: Our use of the adjective cāseārius as a noun.
